title: Create work order raises one estimate per row at the header location
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions. Raising a work order also needs create and edit work orders.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. A schedule built at "Calgary South" with PM-A carrying 3 canned lines; an asset enrolled on it with PM-A listed on the worklist; "Calgary South" chosen in the header.
  4. A unit enrolled on two schedules whose services fall due within a few days of each other.
custom_steps:
1. On the PM-A row press Create work order; read the work order that opens: status, customer, asset, location and lines.
  2. Go back to the worklist and read the PM-A row's Work Order column and button.
  3. Find the two-schedule unit's rows and their buttons.
  4. Look for any way to raise one work order for several assets or rows at once.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A new work order opens in estimate status for that customer and asset, at "Calgary South", carrying PM-A's 3 canned lines.
  • The row's Work Order column links to the new work order, and the button now reads Open work order.
  • The unit has two rows, each with its own Create work order.
  • There is no multi-asset work order; one work order is created per row.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (S13-R14, S13-R17, S13-R30, S13-R38, S13-E1); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R30: “Create work order creates a work order, in estimate status as every new work order starts, for that customer and asset, at the location chosen in the header per S13-R38. At the schedule's home location it adds the service's canned lines per S16-R19”
  • S13-R38: “Create work order raises the work order at the location chosen in the header, as creating a work order does today”
  • S13-R30: “It opens the work order, and the row's Work Order column then links to it per S13-R14”
  • S13-E1: “A unit on two schedules whose services fall close together produces two rows, each with its own Create work order”
  • S13-R17: “A work order is created per row. There is no multi asset work order”
